title: Relative Representations Enable Portable White-Box Monitoring Across Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28366v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways. We show that models do in fact organize information similarly by using specific behavioral probes that operate on compatible representations. This unlocks portable white-box monitoring: a probe developed and validated on one model can be reused when the model changes, without requiring labeled target data. To overcome incompatible native activation coordinates, we express each example through its angular distances to a shared set of anchors. We introduce a global anchored construction that summarizes information from all transformer layers and removes model-specific layer selection, so the same frozen probe can be straightforwardly applied to another model. translated_title: 相对表征使白盒监控能够跨语言模型移植
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28366v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：独立训练的自回归语言模型往往具有相似的能力，但尚不清楚它们的内部表征是否以兼容的方式组织与行为相关的信息。我们通过使用在兼容表征上运行的特定行为探针，证明不同模型实际上确实以相似的方式组织信息。这解锁了可移植的白盒监控：在一个模型上开发和验证的探针，可以在模型更换时被复用，而无需带标注的目标数据。为了克服各模型原生激活坐标不兼容的问题，我们通过每个样本到一组共享锚点的角度距离来表达它。我们引入了一种全局锚定构造，它能汇总所有 transformer 层的信息，并消除了模型特定的层选择，因此同一个冻结的探针可以直接应用于另一个模型。我们在监控任务上评估了跨模型的探针迁移效果（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现不同语言模型的内部表征可通过相对角度距离映射到兼容空间，使在一个模型上训练的行为探针无需目标模型标注数据即可直接复用，从而实现可移植的白盒监控。
en_tdlr: By expressing activations as angular distances to a shared set of anchors across all transformer layers, behavioral probes trained on one language model can be directly reused on other models without labeled target data, enabling portable white-box monitoring.
